title: aliasctl.yaml
description: Project-scoped aliases, functions, variables and required tools for AliasCtl. aliasctl validate is the source of truth; this schema is for editor help.

version.description: Config format version. Optional; a missing value means 1.

name.description: Environment name, shown in the prompt as (aliasctl:<name>).

variables.description: Exported variables. Aliases can use them as ${NAME}.

aliases.description: Structured commands, not shell code: no pipes, redirects, globs or $VAR. Use functions for shell code.

functions_fish.description: Fish function bodies; fish never runs the bodies under functions.

tools.description: Tools the commands need, checked by aliasctl tools check.

check.description: Command that prints the version. Same rules as an alias.

timeout.description: How long the check may take, e.g. 10s. Defaults to 5s.

mise.description: mise tool name or backend used by aliasctl tools install, e.g. aqua:hashicorp/terraform. Defaults to the tool name.

versionRule.description: "*", a bare version that pins the parts it names (1.22 matches 1.22.x), or space-separated >= > <= < = comparisons.
